title: The Rule of 72: How Wealth And Debt Double
hook_text: YOUR DEBT IS GROWING FASTER THAN YOUR WEALTH

beats.say: Your debt is growing much faster than your wealth, and the math explains why.
beats.visual: A dark wooden desk with a single unlit desk lamp casting a sharp shadow.

beats.say: It's called the Rule of 72. It reveals the hidden speed of your money.
beats.visual: A close-up of a vintage metallic gear turning slowly in dim moody lighting.

beats.say: Take an 8% investment return. Divide 72 by 8, and you get 9.
beats.visual: Macro shot of silver coins stacked neatly on a dark concrete surface.

beats.say: That means at 8%, your invested money doubles every 9 years.
beats.visual: A single pendulum swinging smoothly against a dark, out-of-focus background.

beats.say: It sounds steady. But then you look at what happens on the other side.
beats.visual: An empty city street at dusk, viewed from a high window with soft blue tones.

beats.say: Look at a 24% credit card APR. Divide 72 by 24, and you get 3.
beats.visual: A dark leather wallet resting on a polished wooden tabletop.

beats.say: At 24%, your debt doubles every 3 years without extra payments.
beats.visual: A close-up of water droplets falling onto a dark, still pool of water.

beats.say: While your investments take 9 years to double, your balance triples that speed.
beats.visual: A heavy iron key lying on a dark, weathered timber board.

beats.say: That's why a $6,000 credit card balance can trap you for 21 years.
beats.visual: An old brass hourglass with dark sand running through the center.

beats.say: The system is built so debt moves at sprint speed while wealth walks.
beats.visual: A silhouette of a person walking away down a long, dimly lit corridor.

beats.say: Once you see the calculation, you stop playing a losing game.
beats.visual: A blank notebook page under a sharp overhead spotlight with deep shadows.

beats.say: That's why you need to follow for the money rules school never taught you
beats.visual: A closed heavy wooden door with a soft warm light glowing underneath.

caption: The math they never taught you about how fast debt outpaces your investments. #RuleOf72 #PersonalFinance #DebtFree #MoneyTips #FinancialLiteracy
description: Discover the Rule of 72 and how your investments double every 9 years while high-interest debt doubles every 3 years.
first_comment: Did you know your debt was moving this fast?

facts.claim: $6,000 credit card at 24% APR paying only the minimum takes 252 months (~21 years)
